An '''orthonormal function system (ONS)''' is an [[orthonormal]] [[basis (linear algebra)|basis]] in a [[vector space]] of [[Function (mathematics)|functions]].<ref>{{citation|title=Companion to Concrete Mathematics|series=Dover Books on Mathematics|first=Z.
